For Respondents 2 to 4 : Mr.K.Ravikumar,

ORDER The matter is listed under the caption for dismissal today.
There is no representation on the side of the petitioner.
Even on the last occasion i.e., on 12.12.2019, there was no representation on the side of the petitioner.
It can now be inferred that the petitioner is not interested in prosecuting this petition.
Accordingly, this writ petition is dismissed for non- http://www.judis.nic.in prosecution.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
